bull.b: The highly recurring revenue model supports visibility and customer lifetime value. Contracted subscriptions can expand with usage, channels and features, creating a durable base for predictable growth.

Strong current growth, expanding contracted backlog and reiterated FY27 targets indicate durable demand for Braze’s platform. RPO growth also provides forward revenue visibility as enterprise contracts convert.

Net retention above 100% shows existing customers are expanding spending, while large-account growth strengthens enterprise positioning. This supports efficient growth through upselling rather than relying solely on new logos.

bear.b: Braze has not yet reached sustainable GAAP profitability, and its historical growth rate has decelerated materially. Continued investment is therefore required before the business demonstrates durable earnings power.

Premium messaging volumes and carrier fees can structurally pressure margins as the business scales across channels. Passing fees to customers may help, but mix and delivery costs could limit operating leverage.

Fast expansion of delivery capacity and sales resources increases execution complexity. Delays in hiring, ramping or product delivery could constrain enterprise growth and raise costs before expected productivity is achieved.
